The form posts a flat JSON lead (first_name, last_name, email, phone, address1, city, postal_code, tag, source, utm_*) straight to it, then sends the buyer to a pre-filled checkout. One URL per line if you also want a second endpoint (e.g. the Vendo OS relay).
